title: Spring Data Analysis API
description:
Spring Data Analysis API is a Spring Boot–based data analysis REST service that ingests CSV files and automatically profiles their structure and content. It extracts metadata such as column types, null counts, and statistical summaries, then persists results for later retrieval. The API is designed for real-world data engineering workflows including dataset exploration, data quality assessment, and ETL validation.

Key capabilities

  • CSV ingestion and automatic data profiling
  • Column type detection and null count analysis
  • Statistical summaries for numeric fields
  • Persistent storage of analysis results
  • REST endpoints for upload, download, and deletion
  • Swagger UI for interactive API testing
techStack: Tech Stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3, Gradle, GCP, JPA, H2, Lombok, JUnit 5, Linux

title: BCS Student Placement Portal
description:
BCS Student Placement Portal is a web-based placement matching system developed for BCS Manchester to increase undergraduate placement uptake by matching university students with employers offering year-long industrial placements. The system supports students, employers, university career staff, and administrators, with matching logic aligned to SFIA Version 8.

Key capabilities

  • Role-based user accounts for students, employers, career staff, and administrators
  • Session-based authentication and access control
  • Student profile management with CV upload (PDF)
  • SFIA v8 skill and level management
  • Placement creation, management, and shortlisting
  • Skill-based placement matching and notifications
  • Career staff dashboards for monitoring outcomes
  • Responsive UI with role-specific dashboards
techStack: Tech Stack: PHP, SQLite, Bootstrap 5, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, SFIA v8

title: Transform My Raw Data
description:
Transform My Raw Data is a data analysis platform that turns uploaded files into structured insights. It validates input, processes large datasets, and returns detailed statistical results in real time.

  • Downloadable analysis results
